description: FREE: manage an alert subscription bought with subscribe_alerts. action=status (state, deliveries left, expiry), events (the last 14 days with payloads, since= to catch up), test (send a test delivery), resume (re-activate a suspended one, optionally at a new url) or cancel (no refund).

since.description: events: ISO-8601 time to start from, e.g. 2026-10-20T08:00:00Z

url.description: resume: a new public HTTPS webhook URL (optional)

name: manage_alert_subscription
